key_seed: agw-evidence-v2 conformance test key -- public, never use for anything real
note: Expected results are written from RFC-0009, not generated by any verifier. The key is SHA-256(key_seed) used as an Ed25519 seed; it is public and must never sign real evidence.

hash_vectors.name: multibyte UTF-8: lengths are bytes, not characters

verify_vectors.name: intact_fully_anchored
verify_vectors.description: Six records, checkpoints after 3 and 6.

verify_vectors.name: intact_unanchored_tail
verify_vectors.description: The last checkpoint covers seq 3; records 4-6 are chained but unsigned.

verify_vectors.name: chain_only_without_key
verify_vectors.description: No key given: links and hashes are checked, signatures are not, and no unanchored problem arises.

verify_vectors.name: blank_lines_ignored
verify_vectors.description: Whitespace-only and empty lines are skipped.

verify_vectors.name: timestamp_offset_normalised
verify_vectors.description: Record 1's timestamp is written with a +05:30 offset and padded nanoseconds; TS() normalises it to the hashed form.

verify_vectors.name: superseded_v1_record
verify_vectors.description: A v1 record verifies under v1 rules and is reported, without clearing intact.

verify_vectors.name: anchor_honest_growth
verify_vectors.description: The anchor is the checkpoint at 3; the log has legitimately grown past it.

verify_vectors.name: content_edited
verify_vectors.description: Record 2's decision flipped from deny to allow; nothing else changed.

verify_vectors.name: record_deleted
verify_vectors.description: Record 2 removed. Record 3 now follows 1: wrong seq, wrong link.

verify_vectors.name: records_reordered
verify_vectors.description: Records 4 and 5 swapped. Each is out of sequence and mislinked, and so is record 6, which links to 5 but now follows 4. The checkpoint at 6 still matches: it commits to record 6's own hash, and record 6 was not altered.

verify_vectors.name: checkpoints_stripped
verify_vectors.description: Every checkpoint removed, verified with a key: nothing is pinned.

verify_vectors.name: rewritten_and_rechained
verify_vectors.description: Record 2 altered and every later hash recomputed; the original checkpoints no longer match the new heads.

verify_vectors.name: checkpoint_foreign_key
verify_vectors.description: The final checkpoint is signed by a key other than the one given.

verify_vectors.name: rollback_detected_by_anchor
verify_vectors.description: Truncated exactly after the checkpoint at 3. Alone it verifies; the anchor at 6 shows three records gone.

verify_vectors.name: rollback_invisible_without_anchor
verify_vectors.description: The same truncation, no anchor: RFC-0009 §5 -- nothing in the file can reveal it.

verify_vectors.name: anchor_missing
verify_vectors.description: The anchor names seq 6, the log reaches 6, but its only checkpoint is at 3.

verify_vectors.name: anchor_forked
verify_vectors.description: The auditor's anchor at 3 is validly signed but commits to a different head than this log's checkpoint at 3: two histories.

verify_vectors.name: anchor_invalid
verify_vectors.description: The anchor's signature does not verify under the given key, so it is not compared at all.

verify_vectors.name: duplicate_member
verify_vectors.description: Record 2 names Decision twice. Last-wins parsing would hash it unchanged; RFC-0009 §1 requires rejection.

verify_vectors.name: case_variant_member
verify_vectors.description: Record 2 carries Decision and decision. A case-insensitive parser reads the genuine value and the hash matches, while a case-sensitive reader shows allow. RFC-0009 §1 makes the line malformed.

verify_vectors.name: record_member_missing
verify_vectors.description: Record 3's timestamp key is misspelled. A missing record member is malformed, not a zero value (§2.1).

verify_vectors.name: checkpoint_member_missing
verify_vectors.description: The checkpoint's issuedAt key is misspelled: malformed (§4.1), rather than a signature failure over a zero time.

verify_vectors.name: head_behind_signed
verify_vectors.description: The log repeats record 1 after the checkpoint at 3, so it ends at seq 1 with seq 3 signed. unanchoredRecords is max(0, 1-3) = 0, not a wrapped unsigned value.

verify_vectors.name: timestamp_lowercase_z
verify_vectors.description: A lowercase z. RFC 3339 allows it; RFC-0009 §2.3 does not, because parsers disagree.

verify_vectors.name: timestamp_comma_fraction
verify_vectors.description: A comma before the fraction, which some parsers accept.

verify_vectors.name: timestamp_offset_24
verify_vectors.description: An offset of +24:00, which some parsers accept.

verify_vectors.name: timestamp_ten_digits
verify_vectors.description: Ten fractional digits; some parsers truncate them silently.

verify_vectors.name: timestamp_not_a_date
verify_vectors.description: February 30th.

verify_vectors.name: integer_quoted
verify_vectors.description: HTTPStatus as the string "403". A quoted number is a string (§2.4).

verify_vectors.name: integer_with_fraction
verify_vectors.description: LatencyMS as 1.0: a number, but not an integer.

verify_vectors.name: record_member_null
verify_vectors.description: A null record member is malformed, not an empty string.

verify_vectors.name: event_member_null_is_absent
verify_vectors.description: A null event member is absent, and hashes as its zero value (§2.2), so this record still verifies.

verify_vectors.name: event_member_unknown_is_ignored
verify_vectors.description: A member the table does not define is ignored and not hashed.

verify_vectors.name: malformed_line
verify_vectors.description: A truncated JSON line between records 2 and 3.

verify_vectors.name: unknown_version
verify_vectors.description: Record 3 declares a version the verifier does not implement; it is refused, not guessed at.

verify_vectors.name: hash_uppercase
verify_vectors.description: Record 1's hash written in uppercase hex. Hashes are lowercase; this is a different string.
